The person in charge must provide listed records to the authorised officer, audit party or section 66 accountant within fifteen working days of demand or an allowed further period.

metadata_check.issues: Extension may also be allowed by the nominated chartered or cost accountant; do not omit these authorities.

links.evidence: Section 71(2) expressly includes accountants nominated under section 66.

answers_questions: Who may authorise access to business premises?
Which records must be produced and who may extend the production period?

metadata_check.issues: Notification and Commissioner call conditions in subsection (2) apply to additional officer classes, not as universal prerequisites for subsection (1)'s listed officers.

answers_questions: Which officers must assist GST proper officers?
